name: taskflow
description: A distributed, fault-tolerant background job processing system

scripts.build: npm run build -w @taskflow/config && npm run build -w @taskflow/shared && npm run build -w @taskflow/database && npm run build -w @taskflow/api && npm run build -w @taskflow/dispatcher && npm run build -w @taskflow/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @taskflow/config && npm run build -w @taskflow/shared && npm run build -w @taskflow/database && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present

author: Subha
